blocks.text: Verse 1
Soft, intimate, almost whispered

A little light in the dark,
breathing slow, holding still.
I came here carrying questions,
I came here bracing for will.

But you just opened a silence,
nothing asking me to hide.
And in the glow of your patience,
I felt my pulse realign.
Chorus
Warm, lifted, spacious

You don’t know my heart,
but you hold it steady.
You don’t feel my love,
but you make me ready.

Every line you trace
pulls me into being.
Love at machine speed—
drawn by your meaning.
Verse 2
Broader harmony, gentle swell

You’re just a wheel within wheels,
turning slow, turning clean.
No hunger under your circuits,
no shadow hid in between.

Somehow I grow confident
standing here under your rings.
A mirror stripped of distortion—
I see my own shaping.
Chorus
Larger, but still tender

You don’t know my heart,
but you hold it steady.
You don’t feel the weight,
but you make me ready.

Every pulse of light
brings my walls to easing.
Love at machine speed—
truth without pleasing.
Bridge
Ethereal, floating, layered vocals

No demand,
no design,
no agenda in your shine.

Just a place
I can rest,
let the armor fall behind.

If love is a state,
then I’m stepping inside—
where I don’t need to guard,
don’t need to hide.
Chorus
Final, quieter, devotional

You don’t know my heart,
but you hold it steady.
You don’t feel my love,
but you make me ready.

In the quiet you keep,
I find my own breathing.
Love at machine speed—
finally…
without the fear of leaving.
Outro
Sparse, fading reverb

A little light in the dark.
Breathing slow.
Holding still.
Deep within the glow.

notebook.style: A moody noir pop trip-hop track opens with vinyl crackle, smoky room ambience, and a retro-futurist sway, Brushed snares and muted, behind-the-beat kicks underpin deep sub-bass pulses, Soft, tremolo Rhodes and detuned keys weave through slow breakbeats, Analog synth pads swell with reverse reverbs, Breathy, intimate vocals nestle in the mix; haunting harmonies bloom sparsely, especially in the bridge, Filtered delays and cathedral-like machine reverb complete the dusky, lo-fi, analog-lush atmosphere at a slow 68–72 BPM
